text:
Situation: Acetaminophen 10 mg/mL 100 mL bags (NDC 36000-306-60, Baxter Healthcare Corporation) are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 497 bags (26.9 days). Corvale General holds 300 bags (15.7 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 37 bags (8.8 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include acetaminophen as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Lakeside inventory is below two weeks. East and General have sufficient stock to support a transfer without dropping below 14 days. B. Braun Medical Inc., Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Caplin Steriles Limited are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 22 bags from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. Transfer 22 bags from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
3. Purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
5. Purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
